scripts.check-deploy-id: grep -qE '^DEPLOYMENT_ID=AKfy' .env.local 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ 正式部署 ID 已設定' || (echo '❌ 請在 api/.env.local 設定 DEPLOYMENT_ID=<正式部署ID>' && exit 1)
scripts.deploy: yarn check-deploy-id && clasp push && clasp deploy -i $(grep '^DEPLOYMENT_ID=' .env.local | cut -d= -f2)
scripts.check-staging-id: grep -qE '^STAGING_DEPLOYMENT_ID=AKfy' .env.local 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ 測試部署 ID 已設定' || (echo '❌ 請在 api/.env.local 設定 STAGING_DEPLOYMENT_ID=<測試部署ID>' && exit 1)
scripts.deploy:staging: yarn check-staging-id && clasp push && clasp deploy -i $(grep '^STAGING_DEPLOYMENT_ID=' .env.local | cut -d= -f2)
